name: Logitech G815 / G915 keyboards
description: Per-key lighting of the Logitech G813 and G815 (wired) and the G915 and G915 TKL (wired, and through their LIGHTSPEED receivers 0xC541, 0xC545 and 0xC547, the last one after a read-only name probe) over HID++ per-key frames. Adapted from OpenRGB's LogitechG815Controller and LogitechG915Controller (GPL-2.0-or-later); untested on hardware. OpenRGB's direct-mode writes to feature 0x4522 (key disabling) and its 0x8071 cluster-effect writes with the persistence byte set are not sent, nor any hardware effect. The G213 (0xC336) is held back. Protocol notes: docs/hardware/logitech-keyboard.md.
